title: Counter decrement overhead
statement: For a finite Boolean word $w$ and a natural number $r$, define its counter overhead to be the sum over $j=0,[1m\ldots[0m,r-1$ of twice the length of the initial run of false bits in the counter word after $j$ steps, plus two.
